articleTitle: Photonic techniques for use on the Atacama Large Millimeter Array
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Progress on a photonic local oscillator that may be suitable for the Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) is described. The proposed system is based on the coherent heterodyne of 1550 nm infrared signals generated at a central location and then distributed over optical fiber to each antenna. The length of each fiber is held constant by a servo system which uses an optical interferometer to measure the fiber path length. The difference between the two laser frequencies is converted at the receivers to a radio frequency (RF) signal by a high-speed photomixer.

articleTitle: Practical photonic beamforming
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The impetus for future array antenna systems has revolved around the demands for increased capabilities in array antennas including larger arrays higher power and better angular resolution, wide bandwidths, reconfigurability and higher operating frequencies. In order to move microwave photonics technology for array antennas beyond the proof-of-concept phase and to compete with alternate approaches, the community must be quicker to grasp the systems issues involved. This paper surveys some of the photonics techniques for optical control of array antennas, addresses the system-level issues for technology insertion and discusses some of the competing technologies.

articleTitle: Progress of instrumentation and measurement toward millimeter-wave photonics
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: This paper will review the latest of several instrumentation and measurement technologies in millimeter-wave photonics, especially using 1.3/1.55-/spl mu/m-wavelength-based techniques. Progress of key technology and state-of-the-art system applications will be described.

articleTitle: Application of uni-traveling-carrier waveguide photodiodes in base stations of a millimeter-wave fiber-radio system
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We propose a remote base station using a uni-traveling-carrier waveguide photodiode without a millimeter-wave amplifier. By using this setup that yields 0-dBm RF output at 40 GHz, error-free wireless transmission is confirmed after 20-km fiber propagation.

articleTitle: New schemes for improved opto-electronic oscillator
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We have demonstrated a compact Opto-Electronic Oscillator (OEO) with integrated laser and modulator, and miniature amplifier and filter. Also we have successfully implemented a carrier suppression noise reduction technique with an optical fiber delay line, and applied the technique to reduce the close-to-carrier 1/f noise in a double loop OEO. Finally, we have demonstrated an OEO with a submillimeter microspherical resonator in place of kilometers of fiber delay. Further improvements of these techniques are expected in the near future.

articleTitle: Development of fiber-radio systems for cellular mobile communications
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: This paper presents the link topology and the performance of three fiber-radio systems for cellular mobile communications. These systems are to be applied to radio shielded areas, such as tunnels of highways, underground malls and in buildings.

articleTitle: High power uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Photoresponse characteristics of InP-InGaAs UTC-PDs and their potential as high power devices are discussed. A fabricated UTC-PD with an InGaAs absorption-layer thickness W/sub A/ of 220 nm and a collection-layer depletion thickness W/sub C/ of 300 nm yielded high pulse-photocurrent up to 184 mA with an associated FWHM of 4.8 ps for a junction area of 40 /spl mu/m/sup 2/. A comparison of the optical RF response between UTC-PDs and conventional pin PDs has shown higher output capability of the UTC-PD at low bias.

articleTitle: Optically controlled millimeter wave antenna
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We have developed an optically-controlled, millimeter wave (MMW) scanning antenna. A computer controlled light source photo-injects a spatially varying plasma into a photoconducting wafer. The light-modified wafer forms MMW beams from 20 to 100 GHz and scans them /spl plusmn/30/spl deg/ in two-dimensions. Beam scan rates are greater than 1000 beams per second with excellent beam control in software. Scanning antennas based on this approach promise to be fast, inexpensive, and easily controlled.

articleTitle: Fabry-Perot type resonantly enhanced Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A novel resonantly enhanced Mach-Zehnder modulator with 10 dB enhancement in link performance is demonstrated. Enhancement is achieved through placement of the electrode structure within a Fabry-Perot type cavity. Theoretical prediction and experimental verification are presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of WDM grating-based optical microwave filter with arbitrary impulse response
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A new grating-based wavelength multiplexed photonic signal processor is presented. This uses a wavelength mapping and partitioning concept, forming a highly parallel delay-processing function. A significant increase in number of taps realised with minimum interconnects, and the ability of generating arbitrary discrete impulse response is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Integrated antenna base station design for hybrid fibre radio networks
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A printed antenna structure suitable for integration with optoelectronic devices in the base station of fiber-radio networks is presented. The stacked patch antenna utilizes the semiconductor material and a low dielectric constant laminate to yield a broad bandwidth and high surface wave efficiency. Experimental verification of the printed antenna is given.

articleTitle: Exact millimetre wave frequency synthesis by injection locked laser comb line selection
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Exact synthesis of millimetre-wave signals has been realised for the first time by heterodyne detection of DFB lasers locked to an optical frequency comb generator. Signals were generated in the range 10 to 40 GHz with SSB noise of -74 dBc/Hz at 100 kHz offset.

articleTitle: Eight beam prototype fiber optic Rotman lens
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A prototype fiber optic Rotman lens was designed and fabricated using silica glass planar waveguide couplers, and precision lengths of single mode optical fiber. The form-factored photonic beamformer was integrated with a wideband linear antenna array to provide eight beam pointing directions corresponding to /spl plusmn/7.5/spl deg/, /spl plusmn/22.5/spl deg/, /spl plusmn/37.5/spl deg/, and /spl plusmn/52.5/spl deg/. Azimuthal antenna patterns were recorded for all beams at frequency increments of 500 MHz over the 2.0 to 4.0 GHz band to demonstrate squint free performance.

articleTitle: Real-time photonic analog-digital converter based on discrete wavelength-time mapping
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A real-time two-channel photonic analog-digital converter operating at >2 GSPS has been constructed and demonstrated for the first time, to our knowledge. The architecture is based on the time-interleaving of discrete, spectrally-distinct optical pulses.

articleTitle: An ultrawideband image rejecting microwave downconverter using WDM
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A microwave-photonic frequency shifting system capable of 60 dB image rejection over a DC to 18 GHz bandwidth is described. The final IF band can exist within the original RF frequency range with 60 dB isolation. The system allows antenna remoting via optical fiber, and maintains phase coherence through the use of WDM techniques.

articleTitle: InP/InGaAs bipolar phototransistor as a front-end photoreceiver for HPR distribution networks
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The assessment of an improved InP/InGaAs phototransistor as a front-end photoreceiver for a hybrid fibre radio (HBF) link was realised. The phototransistor performances were investigated as a direct photodetector and as an up-converting mixer. A preliminary system evaluation of the device was performed.

articleTitle: A novel photonic technique using a dynamic Bragg grating in InP:Fe for microwave modulation frequency control of fibre-wireless systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A dynamic Bragg grating in iron doped indium phosphide is designed to detect a given difference between two optical frequencies. This characteristic is experimentally demonstrated for a 1.55 /spl mu/m optical source modulated at 25 GHz.

articleTitle: Gain and bandwidth enhancement of directly modulated analog fiber optic links using injection-locked gain-coupled DFB lasers
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We report on the experimental demonstration of directly modulated analog fiber optic links with gain-coupled DFB lasers under strong optical injection locking. Successful transmission of BPSK signals up to 18 GHz has been achieved.

articleTitle: Crosstalk reduction in an optical MM-wave/DWDM overlay for radio-over-fibre distribution
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We analyse the generation of optical crosstalk in a MM-wave/DWDM overlay supporting radio-over-fibre transmission. We demonstrate the application of an electrical predistortion technique to suppressed optical carrier modulation, reducing crosstalk by more than 20 dB.

articleTitle: Beam-steering and multibeam formation of Ku-band phased array antenna using optical signal processing beam-forming network
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate two types of spatial optical signal processing beamforming networks (BFN) for array antennas at Ku-band. One is a one-dimensional beam-steering antenna and the other is a multibeam antenna.

articleTitle: Hybrid fiber radio for second and third generation wireless systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The use of hybrid fiber radio (HFR) access technology for 2/sup nd/ and 3/sup rd/ generation radio systems, namely GSM and UMTS is discussed. Dynamic range and maximum output power are shown to be two important criteria for implementing cellular HFR, such that these are evaluated and operational bounds established.

articleTitle: Broadband MM-wave fibre-radio upconverter using a self-oscillating optoelectronic mixer
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A low-cost millimetre-wave fibre-radio transmitter has been constructed using a single pHEMT configured as a subharmonic optoelectronic self-oscillating mixer. Conversion gain was achieved, allowing transmission without the use of amplification across a short radio path.

articleTitle: Coplanar phased array antenna with optical feeder and photonic bandgap structure
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A novel coplanar broadband dipole phased array sending antenna with optical feeder network and photonic bandgap structure has been developed. Hybridly integrated opto-electronic receivers and high-gain MMIC power amplifiers detect the modulated optical input power and deliver a 20-GHz microwave signal to the antenna elements. A planar photonic bandgap structure surrounding each dipole and its electric feeder line suppresses parallel plate modes of the conductor-backed substrate. The relative antenna bandwidth could be tripled from 7.5% to 22%.

articleTitle: Analysis of IP3 of photodiode using equivalent circuit
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The IMD3 of a p-i-n waveguide photodiode is characterized up to 18 GHz. The observed frequency dependence of the IP3 closely agrees with that obtained from an equivalent circuit analysis of the photodiode.

articleTitle: Optical interfaces without light sources for base-station designs in fiber-wireless systems incorporating WDM
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Simplified optical interfaces for antenna base-stations in full duplex millimeter-wave fiber-wireless systems are realized by reusing the optical carrier used in the downstream transmission, for upstream data transmission. Results from an experimental full duplex link operating at 34-38 GHz with a 155 Mb/s BPSK data stream over 10 km of optical fiber are presented.

articleTitle: Comparison of different IF band modulation techniques for electro-optical upconversion and fiber transmission at 60 GHz
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Direct laser diode IF modulation is compared to external IF intensity as well as phase modulation for electro-optical upconversion to 60 GHz and subsequent fiber transmission. Data transmission experiments at 156 Mbit/s demonstrate the feasibility of the techniques.

articleTitle: Integrated millimeter-wave photonic probes for an on-wafer network analyzer
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A new network analyzer based on ultrafast optoelectronic techniques is presented. It uses integrated and packaged mm-wave-photonic active probes and enables on-wafer measurements of scattering parameters with a bandwidth exceeding 300 GHz.

articleTitle: Progress in the ACTS FRANS project
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: One of the aims of the ACTS FRANS (Fibre Radio ATM Network and Services) project was to demonstrate the concept of radio over fibre through a field trial, namely a "real world" delivery of services-video on demand (VOD), high speed internet, visiophony,...-to customers. For this, all the hardware required for the demonstration (millimetre wave electrical and optical components) was developed by the numerous partners involved in the project. The planned demonstration is schematically described, underlying the main building blocks: the ATM interface (622 Mb/s downstream and 40 Mb/s upstream) to the passive optical network (PON), the self-heterodyne optical source which delivers the modulated optical signal carrying the 27.875 GHz TDM signal (622 Mb/s) and 29.875 GHz LO, the remote antenna unit (RAU) which radiates the TDM signal and converts the uplink radio signal into the optical domain (40 Mb/s stream at an intermediate frequency of 615 MHz) and the customer premises equipment (CPE).

articleTitle: First demonstration of a high power, wide band microwave amplifier based upon an optically coupled transistor
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We demonstrate a microwave amplifier intrinsically broadband matched to 50 /spl Omega/ consisting of a ten element series connected laser diode array and parallel connected photodiode array delivering nearly 200 mW RF with low noise and distortion.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic control of a time-steered millimeter-wave transmit array
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: An ultrawideband, fiber-optic, true time-delay, millimeter-wave array transmitter is demonstrated. The beamformer is based on dispersive-prism, optical-delay lines and exhibits squint-free /spl plusmn/60/spl deg/ steering in azimuth across the entire Ka (26.5 to 40 GHz) microwave band. This is believed to be the first fully functioning demonstration of a photonically controlled wideband, millimeter-wave transmitter system.

articleTitle: A WDM architecture for millimeter-wave fiber-radio systems incorporating baseband transmission
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a WDM architecture for a fiber-fed millimeter-wave wireless system incorporating baseband data transmission with remote local oscillator (LO) delivery.

articleTitle: Substrate removed GaAs/AlGaAs Mach-Zehnder electro-optic modulators for ultra wide bandwidth operation
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: GaAs/AlGaAs electro-optic modulators with push-pull metal electrodes were fabricated using substrate removal techniques. High-speed design considerations indicate that ultra wide bandwidth traveling wave operation with low drive voltage is possible.

articleTitle: Two-tone third-order intermodulation distortion characteristics of an HBT optoelectronic mixer using a two-laser approach
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The third-order intermodulation distortion characteristics of a three-terminal InP-InGaAs HBT optoelectronic mixer are reported for the first time. The SFDR was 94 dB (1 Hz) in down-conversion (3.682 GHz to 300 MHz), and 96 dB (1 Hz) in up-conversion (3.682 GHz to 7.064 GHz).

articleTitle: An experimental study on multi-service radio on fiber transmission system for ITS road-vehicle communications
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: In this paper, we newly propose an integration method of all the several radio services for the Intelligent Transport System (ITS) by using radio on fiber technology. In the proposed method, we use a common radio frequency band to integrate several radio services. In order to confirm the feasibility of our proposed system, we investigate the total transmission performance integrated radio and optical link by transmitting Japanese PHS, PDC and IS-95 CDMA systems. Moreover, we have developed an example radio on fiber demonstrator for ITS, which integrated Electric Toll Collection (ETC) and Japanese PHS systems. We also introduce the configuration.

articleTitle: Simplified BS without light source and RF local oscillator in full duplex millimeter-wave radio-on-fiber system based upon external modulation technique
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A simpler full-duplex radio-on-fiber system using a single light source is investigated. Error-free simultaneous fiber-optic transmission of 60-GHz-band down- and uplink signals over 25-km-long standard single-mode fibers is experimentally demonstrated without serious dispersion problem.

articleTitle: Millimetre-wave signal generation and harmonic upconversion through PM-IM conversion in chirped fibre gratings
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A novel technique for generating and upconverting signals to the millimetre-wave band through phase-to-intensity modulation (PM-IM) conversion in chirped fibre gratings is presented. Experimental results at 28 GHz show an excellent phase noise performance (-87 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz) and BER <10/sup -9/ in QPSK optically upconverted transmissions.

articleTitle: Wavelength controlled variable phase shifter for independently steerable multibeam antenna
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A new type of RF phase shifter controlled by optical carrier wavelength is experimentally demonstrated. A simple optical waveguide on a 62 mm long LiNbO/sub 3/ substrate showed linear phase shift characteristics of over 15,000 degrees by changing the wavelength from 1540 nm to 1570 nm. This wide range implies applicability to wavelength division multiplexed (WDM) systems, where a simple waveguide behaves as multiple variable phase shifters. By integrating an array of this phase shifter and a slab waveguide, a simple BFN for independently steerable multibeam antenna can be realized.

articleTitle: Analog modulation performance of single and multimode vertical cavity surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The analog modulation properties of planar proton implanted vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) are investigated. Multimode VCSELs exhibit a spurious free dynamic range larger than 70 dBHz/sup 2/3/ at all frequencies between 0.5-6.0 GHz, with a peak value of 89 dBHz/sup 2/3/ at 1 GHz.

articleTitle: 12 Gsamples/s real-time analog-to-digital converter based on wavelength division sampling
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: In this paper we present a 12 Gsample/s continuous-time wavelength division ADC system. The system uses the recirculating photonic filter true-time-delay (TTD) for dispersion-free chirp generation. It can digitize continuous-time analog signals at 12 Gsample/s using three wavelength channels at 4Gsample/s and three real-time electronic digitizers operating at 4Gsample/s.

articleTitle: High-speed linear analog multiple quantum well electroabsorption modulator integrated with MMI couplers
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We fabricated an electroabsorption modulator consisting of 14 pairs of InGaAsP/InGaAsP strain-compensated multiple quantum well and integrated with a butt-coupled passive waveguide. The observed extinction ratio was 16 dB at 1.53 /spl mu/m and the bandwidth was over 20 GHz.

articleTitle: 60 GHz optoelectronic mixing with high image rejection ratio (>36 dB)
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Basic concept and configurations of optoelectronic image rejection mixing have been proposed and demonstrated. It was confirmed in a preliminary experiment that a 27 MHz single tone IF signal is up-converted by 60 GHz optoelectronically without any millimeter-wave phase control or filter circuits. A fairly high image rejection ratio of 36.5 dB was also achieved by combining two optical filtering techniques provided by a Fabry-Perot etalon and polarization mode dispersion of polarization maintaining fiber.

articleTitle: High power distributed balanced photodetectors with high linearity
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: A distributed balanced photodetector with high saturation photocurrent has been experimentally demonstrated. The maximum linear DC photo-current of 33 mA/branch is equivalent to 66 mA in single-ended photodetectors. The AC linearity at high photocurrents is also investigated.

articleTitle: Linearization of a narrowband analog optical link using integrated dual electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: For narrowband analog optical transmissions, a novel linear modulation scheme utilizing an integrated dual electroabsorption modulator is proposed and its linearity characteristics are investigated.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic integration of ultrafast photoreceivers
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The requirements on ultrafast photoreceivers are derived from system applications and several integration concepts are presented. Using a waveguide approach, both in the electrical and in the optical domain, high-speed and high-power operation can be achieved.

articleTitle: Effects of direct current modulation on a 60 GHz mm-wave carrier generated by master/slave optical sideband injection locking
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Direct modulation of one of the lasers in a master/slave optical sideband injection locking mm-wave generation scheme is investigated experimentally and theoretically. It is shown that this modulation produces a predominantly phase modulated mm-wave signal.

articleTitle: Multi-GHz components: an industrial perspective
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)

articleTitle: Plane wave transmission response of selectively doped and micromachined silicon wafers under optical illumination
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The optical manipulation of the transmission properties of selectively doped and micromachined silicon wafers is described. This is achieved by means of optically exciting the silicon and inducing pseudo-conducting plasma. Comparisons between theory and experiment are made and consideration is made of the lossy nature of the plasma.

articleTitle: Optical DSB signal based mm-wave fiber-radio system using external modulation technique: ultimate performance
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Optical DSB signal based mm-wave fiber-radio access system is theoretically studied. The laser phase noise effect can be eliminated simultaneously by overcoming the fiber dispersion effect, and the ASE-signal beat noise can also be reduced.

articleTitle: RF sub-carrier optical transmissions using a bus type topology for personal digital cellular systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: This paper proposes a bus topology fiber-optic link that is compact and cost-effective. A wide noise free dynamic range of 70 dBc, and RF transmission of 24 channels is measured using a uncooled FP-LD without isolators.

articleTitle: A wireless photoconductive receiver using impulse modulation and direct sequence code division
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Direct sequence code division is used to enhance an ultrawideband impulse modulated communication system using a photoconductive switch-based receiver. Experimental results show an aggregate processing gain of 44 dB using a 750 MHz spreading bandwidth.

articleTitle: Multi-GHz components: an industrial perspective
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The status of multi-GHz photonic components and fibre-optic links from an industrial perspective is presented. Current and future device performance and availability is discussed. We focus our attention on commercially available, active, bandwidth-limiting devices-the lasers, modulators and detectors required for multi-GHz photonic links.

articleTitle: Continuously tunable phase controller for microwave oscillators by using optoelectronic phase-lock loop
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We have successfully developed a laser-diode-based optoelectronic phase-locked loop (OEPLL) for phase-tracking free-running microwave signals beyond 20 GHz. In this work, we modify the OEPLL system to demonstrate a broadband, frequency-independent, and continuously tunable microwave phase shifter. The key parameters of the OEPLL-based phase shifter (OEPLL-PS) such as the maximum phase-shifting range, tuning accuracy, linearity, insertion loss, long-term phase stability as well as switching response were investigated. We also demonstrate the precise control of relative phase change between two phase-locked microwave oscillators by using the OEPLL-PS.

articleTitle: Multiwavelength analog video transport network
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We report on tests performed to confirm the performance of an 8-channel dense wavelength division multiplexed 1550-nm analog video transmission using directly modulated lasers over 40 km of standard fiber, through two cascaded Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifiers (EDFAs) with sufficient carrier-to-noise and distortion performance. Multiwavelength analog video transport networks provide an end-to-end transparent information pipe with increased service penetration.

articleTitle: Optimization of optical modulation indices in a cascaded radio-to-optic direct conversion radio highway
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimization method for optical modulation indices in a cascaded radio-to-optic direct conversion radio highway in order to equalize the received CNRs of signals from all radio base stations. The CNR performance of the optimized system is shown to be significantly improved over that of the system using identical modulation indices.

articleTitle: Dual-polarisation feed-forward modulation for RF-over-fibre transmission
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a feedforward modulation technique which utilises polarisation-selective modulation of a dual-polarisation optical signal. We demonstrate generation of a high purity 15 GHz carrier using a 2 GHz modulator.

articleTitle: A feasibility study of fiber-optic radio transmission system over IM/DD digital optical transmission network
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a coexistence method between an intensity modulated/direct detection (IM/DD) digital optical communication system and a radio over fiber (RoF) distribution system. In order to investigate the feasibility, we evaluated an experimental testbed and measured the distortion level of the transmitted radio signal and optical digital signal at the receiver.

articleTitle: High bandwidth optical intersatellite link technologies
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: This paper discusses the major technologies and design trades associated with the design and development of optical intersatellite links for global satellite networks. This paper also presents the current status of OISL development efforts.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic applications of MEMS technology
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We describe RF MEMS switches and their applications to tunable filters and switchable antenna elements. We describe different scenarios where RF photonic systems can benefit from RF MEMS device development.

articleTitle: Bandwidth limitation factors and linear characteristics of traveling-wave CPW electro-absorption modulators
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We investigate the bandwidth limitation factors such as phase velocity mismatching and microwave loss in traveling-wave electro-absorption modulators. Linearity characteristics of the modulator are also analyzed for the application in SCM analog optical transmission.

articleTitle: Experimental investigations of a novel optical delay network structure for true time delay antennas at 10 GHz
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: An optical network structure for true time delay (TTD) antennas was investigated. A part of the network was realized by cascading semiconductor optical amplifiers at 1.3 /spl mu/m as switches with nano second switching speed and no measurable crosstalk.

articleTitle: Spectral characteristics of semiconductor lasers under strong optical injection
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We analyze the spectral characteristics of semiconductor lasers under strong optical injection, and show that widely separated multiple sidebands are generated if the laser is in the dynamically unstable regime. Using this, it may be possible to generate optical microwaves/MM-waves without any external RF-sources.

articleTitle: Reference frequency signal transmission over optical fiber for CDMA-based microcellular system
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: The performance of the frequency stability and the phase noise was described when the reference frequency signal is distributed through the optical passive double star network for a CDMA microcellular system. We calculate and measure the short-term frequency stability and phase noise. In our experiments, the frequency of the RF CDMA signal centered at 892.14 MHz was maintained within /spl plusmn/5/spl times/10/sup -8/ stability. Up to 24 CDMA carriers and a control signal were transmitted with the reference signal without violation of IS-97 standards.

articleTitle: Polarization-free operation of external modulators in radio on fiber systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Slow polarization scrambling enables us to place polarization-dependent modulators apart from light sources. The principle was experimentally confirmed. The penalty was sufficiently small as 2 dB when the transmitted signal CNR was 45 dB.

articleTitle: Miniaturized optical and microwave receiver module using double conductor CPWs for active phased array antennas
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Miniaturized optical and microwave receiver module using DCCPWs (double conductor coplanar waveguides) has been developed for active phased array antennas. This antenna requires flexible, lightweight, and low loss feeders to element radiators. This module comprised of a microstrip-to-slot transition, two chips of low-noise MMIC amplifiers, and a laser diode module is fabricated on an ultrathin package with 10/spl times/30/spl times/1.5 mm3 in size and 2 g in weight to achieve an ultra-thin structure of active phased array antenna panels. To provide low noise and ultra-thin size, DCCPWs are employed in the design of input matching circuit of low-noise MMIC amplifiers. In addition, the ultra-thin structure is attributed to the design of laser diode modules using silicon V-groove technology and fiber alignment method.

articleTitle: Pulse to pulse coherency of actively mode-locked laser diodes
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Mode-locked lasers are potentially viable in distribution of frequency reference signals in many distributed systems. Phase noise degradation of the reference signal distributed by a monolithically integrated electro-absorption (EA) modulator with multiple quantum well (MQW) laser diode is investigated. The FM noise degradation dependence on EA modulator bias voltage is correlated to pulse to pulse coherency time.

articleTitle: Photonic signal processing of high-speed signals using fibre gratings
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: Recent developments in the processing of wideband signals using delay lines and fibre gratings are described, including both fixed and programmable sampling processors. Grating processors for high Q microwave filtering, frequency discriminators, tunable filters, fast and adaptive signal correlators, and true-time delay beamforming for phased array antennas, are discussed.

articleTitle: Frequency-converted, polarization insensitive, and dispersion immune photonic link with Brillouin amplification
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We have demonstrated a technique called Brillouin selective sideband amplification (BSSA) for photonic RF signal amplification and signal processing. In this paper, we describe a simple and elegant scheme that utilizes BSSA to eliminate many practical problems and make multi-functional photonic links feasible. In particular, we demonstrate a frequency down/up conversion photonic link that has no polarization sensitivity, no need for biasing the modulators, no fiber dispersion induced signal fading, increased optical power handling capability, built-in optical amplification and increased signal conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: A novel BPSK method using multiple quantum well electroabsorption modulator integrated with MMI couplers
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: We propose novel all optical binary-phase-shift-keyed (BPSK) modulation method. We fabricated the BPSK modulator using a MQW electroabsorption modulator with MMI couplers. It is demonstrated that a carrier signal is /spl pi/-phase shifted as a baseband signal is applied.

articleTitle: Optically controlled CPW InP HEMT MIMIC oscillators designed by an illuminated HEMT model
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP'99. Technical Digest (Cat. No.99EX301)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a novel InP HEMT structure to enhance the photo-response, an illuminated HEMT model for the novel HEMT structure and measurement and large signal simulation of optically controlled MIMIC characteristics.
